tools.name: get_census_data
tools.description: Returns twelve official Census 2021 topic summaries for the LSOA containing a London postcode; no demographic score is produced. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows CensusDataResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

tools.name: get_connectivity_data
tools.description: Returns Ofcom postcode fixed-broadband aggregates and separately dated local-authority mobile coverage, not property-level availability. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows ConnectivityDataResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

tools.name: get_council_tax_rates
tools.description: Returns official annual band A to H charges for the postcode local authority; it does not infer a property band. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows CouncilTaxRatesResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

tools.name: get_deprivation_data
tools.description: Returns published English deprivation ranks and deciles for the containing LSOA; Civic Data adds no score. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows DeprivationDataResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

tools.name: get_epc_data
tools.description: Returns a published domestic EPC, including total floor area, using a full address or postcode plus building number. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows EpcDataResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

address.description: A full postal address, including postcode.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

building_number.description: The building number or name, for example 192 or Flat 3.

tools.name: get_fire_data
tools.description: Returns factual London Fire Brigade incident and response history around a postcode; it is not a risk score. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows FireDataResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

radius_metres.description: Search radius in metres, from 100 to 5000.

years.description: Rolling history period in years, from 1 to 15.

tools.name: get_income_data
tools.description: Returns four ONS model-based mean household-income estimates and 95% confidence intervals for the containing 2021 MSOA; no household estimate or affluence score is produced. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows IncomeDataResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

tools.name: get_property_price_per_area
tools.description: Returns exact Price Paid-to-EPC joins and observed price-per-square-metre and price-per-square-foot quartiles; no estimate is produced. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows PropertyPricePerAreaResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

building_number.description: The building number or name, for example 192 or Flat 3.

radius_metres.description: Use 0 for the exact postcode, or 100 to 5000 metres.

date_from.description: An inclusive date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

date_to.description: An inclusive date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: get_property_sales
tools.description: Returns Price Paid transactions and factual aggregates for an exact postcode or bounded radius; no valuation is produced. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows PropertySalesResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

radius_metres.description: Use 0 for the exact postcode, or 100 to 5000 metres.

date_from.description: An inclusive date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

date_to.description: An inclusive date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: get_property_tribunal_decisions
tools.description: Returns published Residential Property Tribunal index matches; text matching does not establish legal title or liability. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows TribunalDecisionsResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

building_number.description: The building number or name, for example 192 or Flat 3.

date_from.description: An inclusive date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

date_to.description: An inclusive date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: get_radon_data
tools.description: Returns the BGS indicative radon class for the 1 km grid square containing a London postcode centroid; it is not a property test or risk score. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows RadonDataResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

tools.name: get_source_info
tools.description: Lists official datasets, publishers, licences, coverage and freshness used by Civic Data. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows SourceInfoResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

tools.name: resolve_location
tools.description: Returns official geography and coordinates for a London postcode, with source provenance. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows ResolveLocationResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

postcode.description: A UK postcode within London, for example E15 2NE.

tools.name: resolve_uprn
tools.description: Returns the coordinate published in OS Open UPRN; it does not return or infer an address or property attributes. Output is {resultSchema, result}; result follows UprnLocationResponse at https://api.civicdata.co.uk/openapi.json.

uprn.description: A numeric Unique Property Reference Number.
